title: Naturality of localized identity evaluation
statement: Let X be a scheme with a chosen derived category. For complexes L,M,L',M', let H(L,M)=RHom(QL,QM), and let j(L,M):H(L,M)≅QHom(L,I(M)) be the fixed resolution comparison of [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-model]. Define E(L,M):H(L,M) tensor QL → QM as (j.hom tensor identity) followed by the tensor localization model map of [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison], the localized identity uncurrying of [lem-pc-tensor-hom-uncurry-differential], and the inverse localized resolution augmentation. For derived isomorphisms b:QL≅QL' and c:QM≅QM', (RHom(b.hom,c.inv) tensor identity QL) followed by E(L,M) equals (identity H(L',M') tensor b.hom) followed by E(L',M') followed by c.inv. No flatness or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08DJ; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 0A90 and 0A96; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08DJ, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A90, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A96 (read online)

proof.text: Resolve L and L prime by K-flat complexes and use fixed K-injective target resolutions. Compute comparison roofs and derived morphisms into Hom on homotopy classes.

On each tensor summand evaluation commutes with precomposition and postcomposition by tensor-Hom adjunction and Hom projection naturality. Coproduct extensionality gives the chain identities. Uncurrying degree-minus-one cochains preserves homotopies by the signed differential formula.

Localize these identities. Naturality of the tensor model, internal-Hom resolution comparison and augmentation identifies the composites with E. Cancel quasi-isomorphisms in the roofs. Hom into the injective resolution and derived tensor invert the K-flat resolutions, yielding the square for arbitrary L and L prime.

theorem tensorHomEvaluation_natural (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (L M L' M' : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (b : DerivedCategory.Q.obj L ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj L')
    (c : DerivedCategory.Q.obj M ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj M') :
    letI := schemeDerivedTensorMonoidal X
    let E := fun L M : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ ↦
      ((schemeDerivedInternalHomResolutionIso X L M).hom ⊗ₘ
          𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L)) ≫
        pullbackTensorModelMap X (homComplex (R := X.sheaf) L
          ((schemeHomKInjectiveResolution X).obj M)) L ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeTensorHomUncurry X _ L M (𝟙 _)) ≫
        schemeHomResolutionInverse X M
    ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf).map
        (b.hom.op, c.inv) ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L)) ≫ E L M =
      (𝟙 _ ⊗ₘ b.hom) ≫ E L' M' ≫ c.inv
